metric: Median asking price in a sample of exact 3-bedroom, 2-bath home listings
selection: First public results page for each city, in source default order; exactly 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms; matching city in the listing address; duplicate addresses removed. Boston includes official city neighborhoods; New York includes its five boroughs. Jackson Hole uses Jackson, Wyoming addresses. All listed residential home types are included. This is a non-random listing sample, not a comprehensive citywide median or closed-sale series.
